name: New York Fed recent graduates data
measures: Unemployment among recent graduates, by major
about: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York publishes job outcomes for recent college graduates by major, updated once a year. We quote computer science and computer engineering against all majors. It does not affect the score.
license: New York Fed Terms of Use, with attribution
attribution: © 2026 Federal Reserve Bank of New York. Content from the New York Fed subject to the Terms of Use at newyorkfed.org.
limitations: It is published once a year, so there is no monthly trend.
Unemployment among graduates has many causes other than AI.
